scope: Modeled daily-station DMA requirement screen; no observations of hourly temperature, flowering, fruit set, annual yield or economics are inferred.
completeness: Only 100% reconstructed seasonal days count; each day requires paired accepted Tmin/Tmax on previous/current/next dates. No missing values filled. Incomplete seasons cannot classify requirement attainment.
seasonWindow: Northern Oct1-Apr30, southern Apr1-Oct31; seven-month atlas screening convention, not a universal biological deadline. Same calendar-year daily minima are unsuitable for assigning crop freeze losses.
hourlyModel: Two half-cosine segments, Tmin at astronomical solar sunrise and Tmax14:00solar. Evening cooling connects to next-day Tmin; early morning uses prior Tmax. Hourly-bin midpoint sampling; no observed hourly validation performed here.

monthlyNormal.period: 1991-2024 accepted paired daily values; incomplete calendar years retained for climatological means

normalScreen.maximumCUInterpretation: Maximum screening accumulation if the chill kernel continues all season; original DMA changes phase at first requirement attainment.
